entities.name: Member
evidence: The library keeps track of its members.
entities.rationale: Members are explicitly tracked by the library.

attributes.name: membershipNumber
attributes.rationale: Stated as unique, so it identifies a member.

entities.name: Book
entities.rationale: Books are explicitly owned and described.

attributes.name: isbn
evidence: A book is identified by its ISBN

attributes.name: author
attributes.rationale: Modeled as multivalued attribute; Author could also be an entity.

entities.name: Copy
evidence: the library may have many copies
identified by its copy number within the book
entities.rationale: A copy is identified only within its book, so it is weak.

attributes.name: copyNumber
evidence: its copy number within the book
attributes.rationale: Partial key of the weak entity.

attributes.name: employeeId
attributes.rationale: No identifier is given in the text; introduced as an assumption.

entities.name: Section
entities.rationale: Section is managed and located, but has no explicit properties.

attributes.name: floor
evidence: A section is located on a floor
attributes.rationale: Floor could be an attribute or a separate entity.

relationships.name: has
evidence: For each book the library may have many copies.
relationships.rationale: Identifying relationship of the weak entity Copy.

relationships.name: borrows
evidence: A member can borrow many copies, and a copy can be borrowed by many members

relationships.name: manages
evidence: Every librarian is in charge of one section
relationships.rationale: Cardinality on the section side is not stated; 1:1 is a guess.

evidence: An employee is either a librarian or a technician.
generalizations.rationale: 'Either ... or' indicates a disjoint, total specialization.
